usage: trustweave risk-check [-h] --input INPUT [--baseline BASELINE]
                             [--suppressions SUPPRESSIONS] [--output OUTPUT]
                             [--markdown-output MARKDOWN_OUTPUT]
                             [--fail-on {critical,high,medium,low,info,none}]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --input INPUT         Local review artifact JSON; repeat for multiple
                        artifacts.
  --baseline BASELINE   Optional local risk-baseline JSON or YAML.
  --suppressions SUPPRESSIONS
                        Optional local risk-suppressions JSON or YAML.
  --output OUTPUT       Local risk-review JSON output path.
  --markdown-output MARKDOWN_OUTPUT
                        Optional local Markdown summary path; defaults beside
                        the JSON output.
  --fail-on {critical,high,medium,low,info,none}
                        Return status 1 for active findings at or above this
                        severity; defaults to high.
